stance_summary:
Research method first, remit second. Causal question: after the 16-17 Sep central-bank cluster, does this frozen packet still contain a G10 FX/rates discrepancy versus current pricing with a plausible closing mechanism, or are the apparent edges already priced, statistically noisy, un-risk-matchable, or poorly timed?

VERIFIED FACT. Pre-FOMC interest-rate futures assigned a greater-than-90% probability to a 25bp hike (mw_20260916_fomc_hike_pricing). The hike was delivered to 3.75-4.00% (rollup:Fed raises 25bp to 3.75-4.00%). BoJ raised 25bp to 1.25% in a 7-2 vote (last24:2026-09-18:boj-raises-its-policy-rate-to-1-25; rollup:BoJ raises its policy rate to 1.25%). BoE held 3.75% 6-3 with three members preferring 4.00% and a multi-year gilt unwind (last24:2026-09-18:boe-holds-3-75-but-three-members-vote-to-hike). Those events are realized, not pending. US 2Y is 4.76% (252d percentile 100, z 2.89) with a +57bp 1m move; US 5Y 4.86, 10Y 5.01, 30Y 5.34 are all 98th-100th percentile on the same screen; US 2s10s is 25bp (percentile 0.0, z -2.49) (rates:US; xa:opportunities). Canada August CPI holds at 3% with core near 2% (rollup:Canada August inflation holds at 3%, core stays near 2%). BoC held 2.25% and treated broader energy pass-through as a conditional trigger, not an active hike (xa:energy-retained; rollup:BoC minutes flag higher energy pass-through risk). CA 2Y is 3.27% (1y percentile about 97.8); CA-US 5Y is -124bp (xa screen percentile 0.0) (rates:CA). AU 10Y is 5.348 (1y percentile 99.0) while NSW stamp-duty receipts are -24% y/y, volumes -18%, and Sydney/Melbourne home values more than 7% below peak (rates:AU; mw_20260916_au_housing_tightening). Official NZ sovereign yields are unavailable after an RBNZ B2 HTTP 403; NZ-involved rate RV is refused (rates:NZ; known_gaps). NZ Q2 GDP slowed to 0.2% q/q but beat forecasts (rollup:New Zealand Q2 GDP slows to 0.2% q/q but beats forecasts). Carry in the packet is 2Y sovereign differential / 60D FX vol and is explicitly not forward carry, funding, roll-down, or expected return: AUDUSD ratio 0.049, USDCAD 0.32, AUDCAD 0.33; AUDNZD/NZDUSD/NZDCAD carry unavailable (xa:opportunities). VIX 15.44 (percentile 14.7, z -0.84) and HY OAS 270bp (percentile 13.7, z -0.97) are not stress prints. Brent is 130.8 (z 2.40, as_of 2026-09-15) while a Saudi Oman ship-to-ship workaround reduced the extreme oil-supply tail and oil eased modestly (mw_20260916_saudi_oman_workaround). Temperature gauges sit in a 47-53 band across US/CA/AU/NZ inflation, labor, activity, and consumer. US 10Y breakeven is 233bp (percentile 59, z 0.22). Positioning/flow is unavailable (pos:unavailable). Paper books are empty $100m seeds (paper_books). Executable broker prices are absent; ECB FX and official yields are research/reference only. Market-state is stale on NZ_rates. Last-24 surface last refreshed 18 Sep 2026 04:00 ET versus packet cutoff 2026-09-18T22:39:26Z. USDCAD vs WTI is weak (r-squared 0.017); AUDUSD vs AU-US 2Y is weak; AUDNZD vs AU-NZ 2Y is insufficient.

INFERENCE, not fact. The hawkish/energy-shock desk narrative (last24:2026-09-18:desk-thesis; macro:desk-18sep) is already in the US and CA front ends and in the |z|>=2 yield screen. Research method: the opportunity is the gap versus pricing, not the absolute data print; known information needs a new transmission mechanism. Percentile stretch is a yardstick, not a signal, and xa:opportunities states screens are research prompts with no probability or expected-return estimates. CA-US 2Y at -140bp and CA-US 5Y at -124bp are consistent with Fed 3.75-4.00% versus BoC 2.25%, not a demonstrated cross-market mispricing versus an implied path the packet does not contain. AU housing pain is the tightening channel already biting into already-extreme AU yields; fading AU duration or shorting AUD because housing is weak is fighting a known, priced transmission. AUDNZD at 5y percentile 99.96 / z 3.12 and NZDUSD at 5y percentile 8.6 cannot be risk-matched without NZ yields. Low VIX/HY blocks a risk-off expression; they also do not create a risk-on duration-buy while US 2Y has just printed a 3.3-sigma 1m rise. AUDUSD carry ratio 0.049 is economically tiny; AUDCAD carry sits inside a 99.96th-percentile spot print, so any carry bid is poorly timed and likely crowded by price even though Cot is missing.

UNKNOWN. Meeting-by-meeting OIS/terminal after the delivered hike. Holder composition and flow. The official NZ curve. Whether 16-17 Sep CA/AU yield stamps and 15 Sep oil still describe 18 Sep 22:39Z. Whether energy pass-through is actually broadening into Canadian core away from about 2%.

Minimum evidence test fails for every candidate I refuse to manufacture: no explicit market-implied remaining assumption, no precise discrepancy versus that assumption, no independent triangulation that survives weak FX-rates and FX-oil relationships, and no unspent catalyst. I do not construct a rates candidate or a spot candidate. NO TRADE. Actionable only if (1) an observable OIS or futures strip shows a remaining policy gap versus triangulated hard data, (2) RBNZ B2 yields are restored before any NZ-involved RV, (3) a post-cluster catalyst or positioning evidence shows the stretch can unwind rather than extend, (4) Canada core moves away from about 2% so the BoC energy trigger is no longer merely conditional, and (5) unsupported executable levels remain null until actually sourced.
